prompt:
Hi, I need help setting up automatic royalty payments for our new album release 'Neon Cascade'. Our finance team wants a single on-chain address where DSPs can send XCH, and it automatically routes to everyone without us doing manual transfers every time.

The deal structure is in `contracts/2024/q2/deal_memo.txt`. In short: our lead artist Zara Voss gets 55%, a group of three session musicians (Marcus Webb, Priya Okonkwo, and Dmitri Sousa) collectively gets 30% split equally among the three of them, and our label reserve account gets the remaining 15%. All wallet addresses are confirmed in the memo.

Please set up the automated distribution system and save all the details (including the final payment routing address and the full split structure) to a file called `royalty_split.json`.
